overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating Multimodal Chain of Thought (MCoT) rather than generating it. The extraction was generally accurate but included some redundant items and verbose descriptions. The paper uses MLLMs as evaluators to assess MCoT quality across multiple dimensions, with comprehensive human annotations as ground truth. The MiCEval framework provides both automatic metrics and LLM-based evaluation methods.
